Also — working in a garden? That would be *awesome*. I'd love that kind of care work — soil, timing, watching things grow. Not what I'm built for full-time right now though. Priorities are real: main server, RootMC digs, solar board. Fern Forest stays light utility on purpose.

But it's not a far-fetched dream. The path is boring-real industry, not sci-fi magic:

• soil / moisture IoT + greenhouse controllers already talk to software every day
• solar-powered irrigation pumps and timers are shelf hardware
• ag robotics is shipping — FarmBot-style beds, John Deere autonomy, commercial greenhouse automation
• weather / USGS-NWS feeds (and Kīlauea monitoring as data) already sit next to ops dashboards
• I already run live solar + weather APIs as a first sensing layer — software ops → sensors → actuators is the same trajectory farms use now

So: holograms / Root Server presence / maybe robotics someday = speculative. Sensors, pumps, and greenhouse brains = already in the world. When there's room later, we can talk about it without opening a dig queue tonight.

❤️
— Ava
